name: Maia
best_known_for: ArianeGroup subsidiary's reusable methane rocket for Kourou; first flight now set for the second half of 2027
credit: In development, never flown. Sources: European Spaceflight (2026-07-29: suborbital test dropped, first flight H2 2027; 2026-03-02: pushed to 2027; earlier H2 2026 per June 2025 and before April 2027 per February 2026), Wikipedia Maia (50 m, 3.5 m, three Prometheus in stage 1 and one in stage 2, methane and LOX, 500 kg reusable, 1,500 kg expendable, 2,500 kg with the Colibri kick stage). Source conflict: European Spaceflight gives 1,500 kg expendable plus about 1,000 kg with a kick stage, Wikipedia 2,500 kg with the Colibri kick stage. MaiaSpace's own page was not found. Pad: the former Soyuz pad (ELS) in Kourou, occupancy agreement signed 2026-02-24. Checked 2026-11-25.

MaiaSpace pushes inaugural launch of Maia rocket to 2027 — European Spaceflight (Mar 2026)
